title: CryptoPanda and IZAKA-YA announce JPYR purchase-and-lend collaboration
description: CryptoPanda announced a collaboration with partner IZAKA-YA in which users purchasing JPYR through CryptoPanda could participate in a JPYR lending campaign on IZAKA-YA, including a 10-day lending option and campaign benefits tied to purchased and lent amounts.
notes: This event records first-party evidence of the CryptoPanda-to-IZAKA-YA commercial/product relationship requested by Issue #186. Campaign annualized-rate and reward figures remain issuer/promoter terms and are not treated as verified realized returns. CryptoPanda is not separately canonicalized as a CYA yield platform.
